caption: The drawing features a single decorative element centered on a plain, light beige background. The element consists of a square frame with an ornate yellow-gold border. Inside this square, there is an oval opening, also bordered with intricate yellow-gold detailing that resembles stylized floral and leaf patterns. The drawing uses a limited color palette, predominantly shades of yellow-gold for the frame and border, and beige for the background. The decorative square is the only object in the composition and occupies a small area in the center of the otherwise unadorned page. There is also small, faint text written in the lower left corner outside the frame.
title: Metal Frame Daguerreotype (Brass)
